1.zh: 奉　神旨意，照着在基督耶稣里生命的应许，作基督耶稣使徒的保罗
1.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

1.zh: 写信给我亲爱的儿子提摩太。愿恩惠、怜悯、平安从父　神和我们主基督耶稣归与你！
1.en: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

1.zh: 我感谢　神，就是我接续祖先用清洁的良心所事奉的　神。祈祷的时候，不住的想念你，
1.en: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

1.zh: 记念你的眼泪，昼夜切切地想要见你，好叫我满心快乐。
1.en: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

1.zh: 想到你心里无伪之信，这信是先在你外祖母罗以和你母亲友妮基心里的，我深信也在你的心里。
1.en: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.

1.zh: 为此我提醒你，使你将　神借我按手所给你的恩赐再如火挑旺起来。
1.en: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

1.zh: 因为　神赐给我们，不是胆怯的心，乃是刚强、仁爱、谨守的心。
1.en: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

1.zh: 你不要以给我们的主作见证为耻，也不要以我这为主被囚的为耻；总要按　神的能力，与我为福音同受苦难。
1.en: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

1.zh: 神救了我们，以圣召召我们，不是按我们的行为，乃是按他的旨意和恩典；这恩典是万古之先，在基督耶稣里赐给我们的，
1.en: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

1.zh: 但如今借着我们救主基督耶稣的显现才表明出来了。他已经把死废去，借着福音，将不能坏的生命彰显出来。
1.en: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.

1.zh: 我为这福音奉派作传道的，作使徒，作师傅。
1.en: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

1.zh: 为这缘故，我也受这些苦难。然而我不以为耻；因为知道我所信的是谁，也深信他能保全我所交付他的，直到那日。
1.en: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.

1.zh: 你从我听的那纯正话语的规模，要用在基督耶稣里的信心和爱心，常常守着。
1.en: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

1.zh: 从前所交托你的善道，你要靠着那住在我们里面的圣灵牢牢地守着。
1.en: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

1.zh: 凡在亚细亚的人都离弃我，这是你知道的，其中有腓吉路和黑摩其尼。
1.en: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

1.zh: 愿主怜悯阿尼色弗一家的人；因他屡次使我畅快，不以我的锁链为耻，
1.en: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,

1.zh: 反倒在罗马的时候，殷勤地找我，并且找着了。
1.en: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me

1.zh: 愿主使他在那日得主的怜悯。他在以弗所怎样多多地服事我，是你明明知道的。
1.en: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.

2.zh: 我儿啊，你要在基督耶稣的恩典上刚强起来。
2.en: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

2.zh: 你在许多见证人面前听见我所教训的，也要交托那忠心能教导别人的人。
2.en: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

2.zh: 你要和[我]同受苦难，好像基督耶稣的精兵。
2.en: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

2.zh: 凡在军中当兵的，不将世务缠身，好叫那招他当兵的人喜悦。
2.en: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

2.zh: 人若在场上比武，非按规矩，就不能得冠冕。
2.en: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

2.zh: 劳力的农夫理当先得粮食。
2.en: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

2.zh: 我所说的话，你要思想，因为凡事主必给你聪明。
2.en: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

2.zh: 你要记念耶稣基督乃是大卫的后裔，他从死里复活，正合乎我所传的福音。
2.en: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,

2.zh: 我为这福音受苦难，甚至被捆绑，像犯人一样。然而　神的道却不被捆绑。
2.en: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

2.zh: 所以，我为选民凡事忍耐，叫他们也可以得着那在基督耶稣里的救恩和永远的荣耀。
2.en: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

2.zh: 有可信的话说： 我们若与基督同死，也必与他同活；
2.en: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.

2.zh: 我们若[能]忍耐，也必和他一同作王。 我们若不认他，他也必不认我们；
2.en: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

2.zh: 我们纵然失信，他仍是可信的， 因为他不能背乎自己。
2.en: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”

2.zh: 你要使众人回想这些事，在主面前嘱咐他们：不可为言语争辩；这是没有益处的，只能败坏听见的人。
2.en: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

2.zh: 你当竭力在　神面前得蒙喜悦，作无愧的工人，按着正意分解真理的道。
2.en: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

2.zh: 但要远避世俗的虚谈，因为这等人必进到更不敬虔的地步。
2.en: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

2.zh: 他们的话如同毒疮，越烂越大；其中有许米乃和腓理徒，
2.en: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

2.zh: 他们偏离了真道，说复活的事已过，就败坏好些人的信心。
2.en: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

2.zh: 然而，　神坚固的根基立住了；上面有这印记说：「主认识谁是他的人」；又说：「凡称呼主名的人总要离开不义。」
2.en: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”

2.zh: 在大户人家，不但有金器银器，也有木器瓦器；有作为贵重的，有作为卑贱的。
2.en: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.

2.zh: 人若自洁，脱离卑贱的事，就必作贵重的器皿，成为圣洁，合乎主用，预备行各样的善事。
2.en: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.

2.zh: 你要逃避少年的私欲，同那清心祷告主的人追求公义、信德、仁爱、和平。
2.en: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

2.zh: 惟有那愚拙无学问的辩论，总要弃绝，因为知道这等事是起争竞的。
2.en: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.

2.zh: 然而主的仆人不可争竞，只要温温和和地待众人，善于教导，存心忍耐，
2.en: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,

2.zh: 用温柔劝戒那抵挡的人；或者　神给他们悔改的心，可以明白真道，
2.en: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

2.zh: 叫他们这已经被魔鬼任意掳去的，可以醒悟，脱离他的网罗。
2.en: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.

3.zh: 你该知道，末世必有危险的日子来到。
3.en: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.

3.zh: 因为那时，人要专顾自己，贪爱钱财，自夸，狂傲，谤 ，违背父母，忘恩负义，心不圣洁，
3.en: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

3.zh: 无亲情，不解怨，好说谗言，不能自约，性情凶暴，不爱良善，
3.en: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,

3.zh: 卖主卖友，任意妄为，自高自大，爱宴乐，不爱　神，
3.en: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

3.zh: 有敬虔的外貌，却背了敬虔的实意；这等人你要躲开。
3.en: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.

3.zh: 那偷进人家、牢笼无知妇女的，正是这等人。这些妇女担负罪恶，被各样的私欲引诱，
3.en: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

3.zh: 常常学习，终久不能明白真道。
3.en: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

3.zh: 从前雅尼和佯庇怎样敌挡摩西，这等人也怎样敌挡真道。他们的心地坏了，在真道上是可废弃的。
3.en: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.

3.zh: 然而他们不能再这样敌挡；因为他们的愚昧必在众人面前显露出来，像那二人一样。
3.en: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.

3.zh: 但你已经服从了我的教训、品行、志向、信心、宽容、爱心、忍耐，
3.en: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

3.zh: 以及我在安提阿、以哥念、路司得所遭遇的逼迫、苦难。我所忍受是何等的逼迫；但从这一切苦难中，主都把我救出来了。
3.en: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

3.zh: 不但如此，凡立志在基督耶稣里敬虔度日的也都要受逼迫。
3.en: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

3.zh: 只是作恶的和迷惑人的，必越久越恶，他欺哄人，也被人欺哄。
3.en: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

3.zh: 但你所学习的，所确信的，要存在心里；因为你知道是跟谁学的，
3.en: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

3.zh: 并且知道你是从小明白圣经，这圣经能使你因信基督耶稣，有得救的智慧。
3.en: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

3.zh: 圣经都是　神所默示的，于教训、督责、使人归正、教导人学义都是有益的，
3.en: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

3.zh: 叫属　神的人得以完全，预备行各样的善事。
3.en: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

4.zh: 我在　神面前，并在将来审判活人死人的基督耶稣面前，凭着他的显现和他的国度嘱咐你：
4.en: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

4.zh: 务要传道，无论得时不得时总要专心，并用百般的忍耐、各样的教训责备人，警戒人，劝勉人。
4.en: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

4.zh: 因为时候要到，人必厌烦纯正的道理，耳朵发痒，就随从自己的情欲，增添好些师傅，
4.en: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,

4.zh: 并且掩耳不听真道，偏向荒渺的言语。
4.en: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

4.zh: 你却要凡事谨慎，忍受苦难，做传道的工夫，尽你的职分。
4.en: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

4.zh: 我现在被浇奠，我离世的时候到了。
4.en: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

4.zh: 那美好的仗我已经打过了，当跑的路我已经跑尽了，所信的道我已经守住了。
4.en: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

4.zh: 从此以后，有公义的冠冕为我存留，就是按着公义审判的主到了那日要赐给我的；不但赐给我，也赐给凡爱慕他显现的人。
4.en: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

4.zh: 你要赶紧地到我这里来。
4.en: Be diligent to come to me soon,

4.zh: 因为底马贪爱现今的世界，就离弃我往帖撒罗尼迦去了；革勒士往加拉太去；提多往挞马太去；
4.en: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.

4.zh: 独有路加在我这里。你来的时候，要把马可带来，因为他在传道的事上于我有益处。
4.en: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

4.zh: 我已经打发推基古往以弗所去。
4.en: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

4.zh: 我在特罗亚留于加布的那件外衣，你来的时候可以带来，那些书也要带来，更要紧的是那些皮卷。
4.en: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

4.zh: 铜匠亚历山大多多地害我；主必照他所行的报应他。
4.en: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

4.zh: 你也要防备他，因为他极力敌挡了我们的话。
4.en: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

4.zh: 我初次申诉，没有人前来帮助，竟都离弃我；但愿这罪不归与他们。
4.en: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

4.zh: 惟有主站在我旁边，加给我力量，使福音被我尽都传明，叫外邦人都听见；我也从狮子口里被救出来。
4.en: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

4.zh: 主必救我脱离诸般的凶恶，也必救我进他的天国。愿荣耀归给他，直到永永远远。阿们。
4.en: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

4.zh: 问百基拉、亚居拉，和阿尼色弗一家的人安。
4.en: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

4.zh: 以拉都在哥林多住下了。特罗非摩病了，我就留他在米利都。
4.en: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

4.zh: 你要赶紧在冬天以前到我这里来。有友布罗、布田、利奴、革老底亚，和众弟兄都问你安。
4.en: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

4.zh: 愿主与你的灵同在！愿恩惠[常]与你们同在！
4.en: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
